answers.reason: The full professor is a member of the university, but the text does not state that they sit in the senate.
The budget planning round is handled by university leadership, not by a full professor.

Professors are members whose matters are decided or who participate in appointment matters, but the text does not restrict appointment committees exclusively to them, though as a faculty member they take part in faculty matters.
The full professor belongs to the faculty and takes part in its matters.
The study commission is a faculty body dealing with study programmes, which concerns faculty members.
Examination boards decide on student examination matters, not as a general place for professors.
As a researcher holding a chair and leading a research group, internal research funding concerns their matters.
Module revision concerns degree programmes handled in faculty bodies.
Laboratory equipment procurement relates to the full professor's research group and teaching laboratory.
Orientation week planning is for new students.
